A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
QOL in older people is a multifactorial construct, and the relative contribution of different factors to QOL may be different in older people living in the community and in institutions.
the QOL of older adults is a complex phenomenon and that its predictors are multifactorial.
QOL in older people is a multidimensional phenomenon.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the QOL in older adults is a multidimensional phenomenon and its improvement requires an individualized approach, taking into account the particular needs of each group.
QOL is not only a function of the health status of older people, but also of their social environment, including the place they live.
health-promoting behaviors, such as PA and nutrition, are of greater importance in home-dwelled elders than in institutionalized elders.
